note: Old code (origin/main 9e4d1cb) and new code (this PR) run back to back on the same 4-CPU cloud container (Intel Xeon 2.3 GHz, Python 3.12, Redpanda v24.2.7 in docker, REDPANDA_SMP default). Not comparable in absolute terms with the AWS c7i.2xlarge results in results_scaling_*.json; only the old-vs-new ratio is meaningful. latency2 = re-run at 20k/35k/50k msg/s.
